hero.lead: A nation of 1.46 billion that has brought electricity to almost every citizen and installed 171 GW of solar, while more than half its children, at the last national count, could not read a simple text by the age of ten.

capital.heading: India funds itself at home, and now in green. Next, the classroom.

Cut-off yield on the 7.50% green bond due 2056, auctioned 1 October 2026
World Bank low-carbon energy policy financing, June 2024

register.name: 7.50% GOI Sovereign Green Bond 2056
register.note: Notified amount; cut-off price INR 98.20
register.text: The first of five 30-year green auctions in the second half of the fiscal year, for projects that cut emissions.

register.name: Sovereign Green Bonds, H2 2026-27 calendar
register.detail: Weeks of 28 Sep, 26 Oct, 23 Nov, 21 Dec 2026 and 18 Jan 2027 · Second auction notified for 30 October 2026
register.note: Five auctions of INR 3,000 crore, 30-year
register.text: Set in the issuance calendar for October 2026 to March 2027. The total is the sum of the five auctions; the release does not state it.

register.name: Sovereign Green Bonds, first issuance
register.note: Four tranches of INR 4,000 crore, five- and ten-year
register.text: India’s first sovereign green bonds, issued by the Reserve Bank for the Government, with 5% reserved for retail investors.

register.name: Solar Rooftops for Households Program
register.detail: Approved 9 July 2026 · IBRD $820M · Clean Technology Fund $60M · Livable Planet Fund grant $10M
register.note: Supports PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana; $4.2 billion of private loans expected
register.text: World Bank finance for rooftop solar on 10 million rural and urban homes under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, to cut household power bills and build local manufacturing. It is expected to mobilise $4.2 billion of private commercial loans for installations. It serves the energy standard.

register.name: Boosting Job Creation in the Private Sector Development Policy Financing
register.note: Budget support for private-sector jobs
register.text: World Bank budget support for reforms to the business environment, trade and investment openness, and the mobilisation of private capital, with better finance for small firms and women-owned enterprises. It is aimed at jobs for the 11 million young people who enter the labour market each year, for livelihood.

register.name: Rajasthan Highway Modernization Project
register.note: About 800 km of state highways
register.text: Upgrades and maintains about 800 km of Rajasthan’s highways, strengthens road safety and traffic enforcement, and turns the state highway authority into a service-oriented agency. It serves livelihood, by connecting people to markets and work.

register.name: Resilient Action for Development and Disaster Recovery Himachal Pradesh Project
register.note: Recovery after extreme weather; 2.3 million people
register.text: Rebuilds after disasters in Himachal Pradesh: more than 250 bridges, roads and footbridges rehabilitated, stronger early warning systems, and support for community-owned businesses and jobs. It is to benefit 2.3 million people.

register.name: Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU)
register.detail: Approved 2 February 2026 · Co-prepared with the Asian Development Bank
register.note: More than one million better-skilled workers a year
register.text: Upgrades India’s Industrial Training Institutes so that training matches what employers need, in a hub-and-spoke model. It aims at more than one million better-skilled workers a year, with at least a quarter of ITI students women, and at least $680 million of private capital, for livelihood.

register.name: West Bengal Health System Reform Program
register.detail: Announced January 2026 · IBRD · 16.5-year maturity, three-year grace period · Project P506976
register.note: Care for more than 90 million people
register.text: Personal health care for people over 30 across West Bengal, with digital tracking of hypertension and diabetes, climate-resilient health facilities, and maternal and adolescent health in five districts. It serves more than 90 million people, for the health standard.

register.name: Assam Disaster Resilient Hill Roads Development Project
register.detail: Approved 13 January 2026 · One of three Assam projects, $680M in all
register.note: Climate-resilient roads in the hills
register.text: Builds climate-resilient roads and transport hubs in Assam’s hill districts, opening rural access to markets, jobs and services.

register.name: Assam: School Education and Adolescent Wellbeing Project
register.detail: Approved 13 January 2026 · One of three Assam projects, $680M in all
register.note: Primary learning and climate-resilient schools
register.text: Improves learning in primary schools, gives adolescents life-skills training and builds climate-resilient schools in Assam. Education is the standard that sets India’s Coverage.

register.name: Assam Governance and Service Delivery Program
register.detail: Approved 13 January 2026 · One of three Assam projects, $680M in all
register.note: Public finance and state data systems
register.text: Strengthens public financial management, administrative services and the state’s data systems in Assam.

register.name: Punjab Outcomes-Acceleration in School Education Operation (POISE)
register.detail: Approved 25 November 2025 · IBRD · 19-year maturity, five-year grace period
register.note: About 1.3 million primary and 2.2 million secondary students
register.text: Improves the quality of school education in Punjab, using technology to track learning outcomes and adding computer labs, tablets and projectors, with a focus on science and mathematics. It reaches about 1.3 million primary students, more than 2.2 million secondary students and 592,000 children in early childhood education. It serves the education standard, which sets India’s Coverage.

register.name: Maharashtra Project on Climate Resilient Agriculture, Phase II (POCRA II)
register.detail: Approved 25 November 2025 · IBRD · 24-year maturity, six-year grace period
register.note: More than 2 million small and marginal farmers in 21 districts
register.text: Brings digital precision farming to more than 2 million small and marginal farmers in 21 districts of Maharashtra, 290,000 of them women, to improve crop productivity, soil health, nutrient management and water-use efficiency. It aims to raise smallholder incomes by 30 percent. It serves the food and livelihood standards.

register.name: Uttar Pradesh Agriculture Growth and Rural Enterprise Ecosystem Strengthening
register.note: Farm value chains for smallholders
register.text: Develops inclusive, resilient agricultural value chains and enterprises for smallholders in selected districts.

register.name: Maharashtra Strengthening Institutional Capabilities in Districts
register.note: District-led growth
register.text: Strengthens institutional capacity, services and data systems for district-led inclusive growth.

register.name: Enhancing Landscape and Ecosystem Management (ELEMENT)
register.note: Tripura and Nagaland
register.text: Improves landscape management and the benefits for forest-dependent communities.

register.name: Kerala Climate Resilient Agri-Value Chain Modernization (KERA)
register.note: Smallholder agriculture
register.text: Promotes the resilient commercialisation of Kerala’s agriculture for smallholder farmers.

register.name: Second Low-Carbon Energy Programmatic Development Policy Financing
register.note: Budget support for low-carbon energy
register.text: To accelerate the development of low-carbon energy in India.

register.name: Skills for Human Development in Maharashtra (DAKSH)
register.note: Skills and productivity
register.text: Enhances labour market readiness and productivity through skills development.

register.name: Uttarakhand Disaster Preparedness and Resilience Project
register.note: Climate and disaster resilience
register.text: Improves the resilience of key public infrastructure and strengthens emergency response, including for fires.

register.name: Assam Resilient Rural Bridges Program
register.note: Rural connectivity
register.text: Builds green, inclusive and resilient rural connectivity in Assam and strengthens road and bridge management.

register.name: Tamil Nadu Climate Resilient Urban Development Program
register.note: Urban services
register.text: Improves access to climate-resilient urban services and strengthens urban governance.

register.name: Climate Mitigation On-lending Program: National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development
register.note: On-lending for climate mitigation investments
register.text: An AIIB loan to the National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development, to increase the finance available for climate mitigation investments as India moves to a low-carbon economy. It is non-sovereign: it carries no guarantee from the Government of India.

register.name: Puducherry Integrated Urban Livability Improvement Project
register.note: Water, sewers and drains for more than 320,000 people
register.text: Upgrades water supply, builds new sewer networks and rehabilitates drainage in Puducherry, for more than 320,000 people. It serves the water and shelter standards.

register.name: Climate Mitigation On-lending Program: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
register.detail: Approved 26 September 2026 · Non-sovereign · Up to $200M · Borrower NABARD
register.note: On-lending for climate mitigation investments
register.text: An AIIB loan of up to $200 million to NABARD, to increase the finance available for climate mitigation investments as India moves to a low-carbon economy. It is non-sovereign: it carries no guarantee from the Government of India.

register.name: Climate Mitigation On-lending Program: India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited
register.detail: Approved 26 September 2026 · Non-sovereign · Senior debt · Borrower IIFCL
register.note: Renewable energy, storage, sustainable aviation fuel and EV infrastructure
register.text: An AIIB loan to IIFCL, a government-owned development finance institution, for on-lending to climate mitigation subprojects such as renewable energy, energy storage, sustainable aviation fuel and charging infrastructure for electric vehicles. It is non-sovereign: it carries no guarantee from the Government of India. It serves the energy standard.

register.name: Urban Transformation and Investment Program
register.detail: Approved 28 July 2026 · Loan, with $3M of technical assistance
register.note: Supports India’s Urban Challenge Fund
register.text: Supports the Urban Challenge Fund and reforms to city institutions and finances: resilient urban regeneration, transit-oriented development, municipal bonds and digital governance.

register.name: Accelerating Affordable and Inclusive Rooftop Solar Systems Development Program, Subprogram 2
register.note: At least 3.5 million household rooftop systems
register.text: Finances at least 3.5 million household rooftop solar installations under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, with digital application and monitoring systems and the participation of distribution companies. It serves the energy standard.

register.name: Program for Growth, Resilience, Energy Security and Sustainability
register.note: Trade, energy and food security measures
register.text: AIIB support for short-term policy measures on trade resilience, energy and LPG supply, food security, fertilizer support for farmers and rural employment.

register.name: Chennai Climate-Resilient Water Security and Sewerage Project
register.note: Water and sewerage for about 4.5 million people
register.text: Lays more than 170 km of water and sewer lines and upgrades seven water and 38 sewer pumping stations in Greater Chennai, for about 4.5 million people. It serves the water and shelter standards.

register.name: Strengthening Karnataka Public Schools Program
register.note: 500 public school clusters; more than one million students
register.text: Creates 500 integrated public school clusters, from pre-primary to secondary, with better teaching, curriculum, assessment and STEAM learning. It aims to reach more than one million students, for the education standard that sets India’s Coverage.

register.name: Inclusive and Sustainable Bamboo Value Chain Development in Northeast India
register.detail: Approved 25 June 2026 · Small expenditure financing facility · Six northeastern states
register.note: Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland and Tripura
register.text: Finances community projects to grow, use and manage bamboo, and strengthens its cultivation, production and marketing in six northeastern states, with at least one women-led manufacturing facility in each. It gives rural households income that depends less on crops exposed to natural hazards. It serves the livelihood standard.

register.name: Climate Resilient Brahmaputra Flood and Riverbank Erosion Risk Management, additional financing
register.detail: Approved 10 February 2026 · Loan · Adds to the $200M project approved in October 2023
register.note: 63.5 km of riverbank protection; about 600,000 rural residents
register.text: Extends flood and riverbank erosion management to four more reaches of the Brahmaputra in Assam: 63.5 km of riverbank protection, stronger embankments, wetland restoration, flood forecasting and early warning. About 600,000 rural residents benefit, with livelihood support for women and young people. It protects homes, farms and livelihoods against floods.

register.name: Accelerating Affordable and Inclusive Rooftop Solar Systems Development Program, Subprogram 1
register.detail: Approved 2 December 2025 · Policy-based loan · With $3M of technical assistance
register.note: Backs PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, 10 million households by 2027
register.text: ADB policy-based lending for the national scheme that subsidises rooftop solar for homes, up to 3 kW. It supports reforms such as uniform quality standards, collateral-free low-interest loans for low- and middle-income households and model solar villages, towards 10 million households by 2027. It serves the energy standard.

register.name: Upgrading Industrial Training Institutes (PM-SETU)
register.detail: Approved 28 November 2025 · Loan, co-financed with the World Bank
register.note: 650 ITIs in 12 states; at least 1.3 million young people
register.text: Modernises 650 Industrial Training Institutes in 12 states and turns five National Skill Training Institutes into advanced centres for trainers, to improve the employability of at least 1.3 million young people, for livelihood.

register.name: Integrated Ecotourism and Sustainable Agri-Based Livelihood Development in Meghalaya Project
register.detail: Approved 27 November 2025 · Loan · With a $1M technical assistance grant
register.note: More than 8,000 local people; 25,000 hectares of community forest restored
register.text: Builds nature-based tourism facilities and markets for crafts and farm produce in Meghalaya, restores 25,000 hectares of community forest through payments for ecosystem services, and supports climate-smart farming with drip irrigation. More than 8,000 local people benefit, with a focus on women leading enterprises, farmers’ organisations and tourism cooperatives. It serves the livelihood and food standards.

register.name: Assam State Tertiary Health Care Augmentation Project
register.note: Three medical college hospitals
register.text: Turns Gauhati Medical College and Hospital into a super-specialty facility, upgrades the Assam and Silchar medical college hospitals and improves medical education, for the health standard.

register.name: Assam Urban Sector Development Project
register.note: Continuous metered water for about 360,000 residents
register.text: Builds six water treatment plants, 72 million litres a day in all, and 800 km of pipes for continuous metered water in six district headquarters, and improves stormwater drainage in Guwahati. About 360,000 residents benefit. It serves the water standard.

register.name: LEAP 2 loan to AM Green Ammonia
register.detail: Approved 15 October 2026 · private sector · first ACCEL investment
register.note: Not sovereign borrowing; does not add to public debt
register.text: Finances one of the world’s largest green ammonia plants, about 1.1 million tons a year, from a fund financed by JICA and administered by ADB.

register.name: Equity investment in Hygenco
register.detail: Definitive agreements signed 5 June 2026 · IFC about $25M · With Siemens Financial Services and Fullerton Carbon Action Fund
register.note: Green hydrogen and green ammonia plants
register.text: An equity round co-led by IFC for Hygenco, which develops, builds, owns and runs commercial green hydrogen and green ammonia plants in India and operates two today.

register.name: Shriram Sustainable On-Lending Facility II
register.detail: Approved 28 January 2026 · Non-sovereign · Includes up to $100M of private direct mobilisation
register.note: Loans for low-emission vehicles and renewable energy
register.text: AIIB finance for Shriram Finance to on-lend, mainly for the ownership of low-emission vehicles and for renewable energy infrastructure, to speed India’s move to a low-carbon economy. Up to $100 million of it is mobilised directly from private investors. It serves the energy standard.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Sun
items.label: Solar installed, 30 Sept 2026
items.text: Now the largest part of 299 GW of renewable capacity.

items.name: The Grid
items.label: Of people with electricity, 2024
items.text: About 1,400 kWh a person a year, above the 1,000 kWh that Perfect Capita sets for every citizen.

items.name: The Land
items.label: Of land in agriculture, 2024
items.text: Three-fifths of the land is farmed, and one person in eight is still undernourished.

items.name: The Green Bonds
items.label: 30-year green bond yield, 1 Oct 2026
items.text: First issued in 2023; five 30-year green auctions are scheduled from October 2026 to January 2027.
items.alt: The Reserve Bank of India building

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: Nearly two in three still live outside the cities, where schools and clinics are thinnest.

items.name: Akshaya Patra
items.text: School meals for 2.35 million children in more than 23,000 schools.

items.name: Piramal Sarvajal
items.text: Solar-powered water ATMs and purification in villages and city settlements, serving about 657,000 people.

items.name: Mahila Housing Trust
items.text: Women in informal settlements win water, toilets, power and secure tenure: 1.8 million people in 36 cities.

items.name: SELCO
items.text: Solar power, bundled with finance, for more than 110,000 homes and businesses since 1995.

items.name: Pratham
items.text: Teaching children at the level they can read, and the ASER survey that measures it in every rural district.

items.name: Aravind Eye Care
items.text: 78,581 eye surgeries in a single month, most of them for cataract.

items.name: SEWA
items.text: A union of self-employed women, founded in 1972 in Ahmedabad, with its own bank and cooperatives.

coverage.gap_text: Of Indian children could not read a simple text by the end of primary school in 2017. Education is the standard furthest from reach.

guarantees.name: Education
guarantees.note: 44% of children read a simple text by the end of primary school; dated

guarantees.name: Livelihoods
guarantees.note: Above US$4.20 a day; 16% live below it
